title: Your claim payout “closes today”
scenario: After a recent home claim, a caller says your insurer approved a payout but needs updated bank details before the file closes at 5 p.m. They know the claim type and approximate amount.

answers.A: Provide the bank details because the caller knows information only the insurer should know.
answers.B: End the call and check the claim in the insurer app/site or call the number on your policy.
answers.C: Ask the caller to leave a note on the claim, then verify the request through your account.

explanation: Claim information can leak through documents, emails, or vendors. Payment-destination changes need independent verification.
proTip: Claim knowledge is not caller authentication.
